profile.name: Rizky
profile.headline: Backend Developer & CS Student
about: I'm an Informatics undergraduate at Telkom University (2024-2028), originally from Kutai Kartanegara, building backend systems and exploring how software actually breaks.
My focus spans backend development in Go and Java, database design, network protocol analysis, and crypto/Web3, with cyber security as the direction I'm deepening next.

research.narrative: I care about systems that hold up under scrutiny: how services communicate, how protocols can be analyzed and attacked, and how backend architecture choices affect real-world security.

focus.description: Designing and building backend services and APIs with Go and Java.

focus.description: Modeling, querying, and optimizing relational data for real applications.

focus.description: Analyzing how network protocols work and where they can be broken.

focus.name: Crypto & Web3
focus.description: Exploring cryptographic primitives and decentralized systems.
